summary: A new performance calculator: V1/VR/V2, FLEX and flaps for takeoff, VAPP, autobrake and stopping point for landing, drawn on a to-scale runway. Weight & Balance uplinks its weights to it.
releaseNotes: Performance: takeoff speeds, FLEX or assumed temperature and the best flap setting; landing VAPP, autobrake and stopping distance with the 1.15 factor.
A to-scale runway diagram with V1 and VR, the 35 ft and stop flags, the stopping distance and the runway margin.
Weight & Balance can uplink its takeoff and landing weights to Performance.
Performance profiles for the A319, A320, A320neo, A330-900, A350-900, A380, 737-800, 737 MAX 8 and 787-9.
Results update as you type, with a wind compass, weight gauge and density altitude.
Speeds and distances are Stratos estimates for simulator use, not certified performance.
